topic: What happens if you swallow chewing gum
title: What Happens If You Swallow Gum?
description: Does gum really stay in your stomach for seven years? Here is the real journey.
facts_checked: Gum base is not digested but passes through in days -> mayoclinic.org

scenes.line: What happens if you swallow a piece of chewing gum?
scenes.visual: [GUY] frozen mid-gulp with a pink gum ball sliding down his throat, x-ray cutaway of his neck

scenes.line: First, it slides down your esophagus like a tiny pink submarine.
scenes.visual: cutaway of a pink fleshy tube with a small pink gum ball sliding down it

scenes.line: Then it splashes into your stomach, a bubbling pool of acid.
scenes.visual: a pink gum ball splashing into a glowing green bubbling acid pool inside a stomach cavern

scenes.line: The acid melts the sugar and flavor in minutes.
scenes.visual: macro view of a gum ball losing its colour while tiny sugar crystals dissolve around it

scenes.line: But the rubbery gum base? Your body can't break it down.
scenes.visual: tiny cartoon stomach enzymes pulling on a stretchy grey rubber blob that refuses to tear

scenes.line: So it just rides along with everything else you ate.
scenes.visual: a grey gum blob riding on top of food chunks through a winding intestine tunnel like a water slide

scenes.line: And a few days later, it leaves the same way everything does.
scenes.visual: [GUY] sitting on a toilet reading a newspaper looking relieved, cartoon style

scenes.line: Seven years? Nope. Just a very awkward road trip.
scenes.visual: a grey gum blob wearing tiny sunglasses waving goodbye from inside a cartoon tunnel
